title: CFO mailbox takeover after invoice phishing
summary: Business email compromise: session token theft and a hidden forwarding rule.
description: The CFO reported opening a fake supplier invoice link (adversary-in-the-middle login page). Microsoft Entra ID Protection flagged 'Impossible travel' and 'Anomalous token' for the CFO account: sign-ins from London and from 192.0.2.77 (abroad) 9 minutes apart. An inbox rule named '..' now forwards all mail containing 'invoice' or 'payment' to an external Gmail address. One outbound email to a supplier asked to change bank details for a pending EUR 1.2M payment. Unclear yet whether mailbox contents containing customer data were accessed.

sentinel.title: Suspicious inbox forwarding rule after risky sign-in
